The '''Mustafarian Distance Globe''' was an item that could add the Mustafarian Heat Shock effect to a weapon. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Mi Fon Lu]] gave one to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] for defeating the [[Blackguard (Mustafar)/Legends|Blackguard]].

==Behind the scenes==
Mustafarian Distance Globes appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
